prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Katy, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1411; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, if that's okay. You already have it on the claim.

Q: That's fine. Can you confirm the address where you were living at the time of the accident?

A: Yes, it's a townhome in Katy, Texas.

Q: Tell me in your own words what happened on the day of the collision.

A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road, waiting to turn. I had my foot on the brake. Then I felt a hard jolt from behind and my car lurched forward into the intersection.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Only in the mirror, a second before. It was a silver pickup and it didn't look like it was slowing down much.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you go to the hospital or see a doctor afterward?

A: An ambulance took me to the emergency room. They X-rayed my left arm and told me the wrist was fractured. They put me in a splint and I have a follow-up with an orthopedic specialist next week.

Q: Are you having any other injuries, like neck or back pain?

A: My neck is sore and stiff, and I've had some headaches, but the wrist is the worst of it.

Q: Did you give any statement at the scene to the other driver or to police?

A: I told the officer what I've told you. He took the information and wrote a report.

Q: Is there anything you would like to add that we haven't covered?

A: Only that I was not distracted and I was fully stopped when it happened. I just want this handled fairly so I can get back to work and my normal routine.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
